definitions.gloss: wealthy merchant; great merchant; powerful trader
definitions.explanation: A very rich and influential merchant, especially one from the Edo period or earlier Japanese history. Implies not just wealth but also social influence and often cultural patronage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{豪商|ごうしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{屋敷|やしき}→屋敷：12395_yashiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{構|かま}えた→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧。
examples.english: Wealthy merchants of the Edo period maintained grand estates.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{蔵|くら}→蔵：13991_kura⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{豪商|ごうしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建|た}てた→建てる：01189_tateru⟧もので、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{資料館|しりょうかん}→資料館：20143_shiryoukan⟧になっている。
examples.english: This storehouse was built by a wealthy merchant and is now a museum.

examples.japanese: {豪商|ごうしょう}たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{莫大|ばくだい}→莫大：03700_bakudai⟧な{財力|ざいりょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{寺社|じしゃ}→寺社：12645_jisha⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{寄進|きしん}→寄進：22850_kishin⟧や⟦{芸術|げいじゅつ}→芸術：02712_geijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}い→行う：01238_okonau⟧、⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{貢献|こうけん}した→貢献する：21682_koukensuru⟧。
examples.english: Great merchants contributed to the development of culture through their vast wealth, supporting temples and shrines with donations and patronizing the arts.

notes:
Composed of {豪|ごう} (grand, powerful) and ⟦{商|しょう}→商：26727_shou⟧ (merchant, commerce). Primarily a historical term, though it can be used figuratively for modern business tycoons.

CULTURAL NOTE:
In the Edo period, the merchant class (⟦{商人|しょうにん}→商人：03236_shounin⟧) was officially the lowest of the four social classes, yet many {豪商|ごうしょう} accumulated enormous wealth and cultural influence. Families like {三井|みつい}, {住友|すみとも}, and {鴻池|こうのいけ} built commercial empires. Many {豪商|ごうしょう} residences and storehouses (⟦{蔵|くら}→蔵：13991_kura⟧) survive as historical sites.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{豪商|ごうしょう}: Edo-period wealthy merchant
- {豪商|ごうしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{屋敷|やしき}→屋敷：12395_yashiki⟧: merchant's mansion
- {豪商|ごうしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{蔵|くら}→蔵：13991_kura⟧: merchant's storehouse
- {大|おお}{豪商|ごうしょう}: great wealthy merchant

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{商人|しょうにん}→商人：03236_shounin⟧: merchant; trader — the general term, without implying exceptional wealth
- {豪農|ごうのう}: wealthy farmer — the agricultural equivalent, a prosperous landowning farmer
- ⟦{財閥|ざいばつ}→財閥：14232_zaibatsu⟧: zaibatsu; industrial conglomerate — the modern successor concept, referring to powerful business groups
